column1: # Upstream mvm image-tree files deliberately not copied here, as
# <path in mvm> TAB <reason>. The drift gate verifies each path still exists
# at the pinned commit and accounts for it when scanning nix/images/.
# The pin advanced past mvm's W8 deletion (tinylabscom/mvm 62e1116866,
# release v0.18.3), which removed mvm's in-tree image tree outright — the
# three rows that used to record why nix/images/examples/llm-agent,
# copied retired with it. The reasons stand in the history of this file;
# there is no upstream image tree left to ignore files from.
